THE PROJECT

Arka Inventory

Introduction

Arka Inventory needed a website that could explain a complex, Salesforce-native inventory management product to both operations teams and technical buyers.

Kyte designed and developed a Framer site that positions Arka as an all-in-one solution for stock, purchasing, warehouse workflows, and costing, built for growing businesses already using Salesforce.
